title: Card game
description: One game in one language. scripts/build.mjs enforces the same rules, plus that every tag exists in i18n/<lang>.json.

cards.description: Space-separated cards: rank + suit (S ♠ H ♥ D ♦ C ♣), e.g. "AS 10H KD". X = face down, JK = joker, | = gap, trailing * = highlighted.

caption.description: One sentence that says what the drawing shows. It is what the text version reads.

id.description: Same as the file name, and the same in every language.

aliases.description: Other names people search for, including the English name.

keywords.description: Extra search words that are not shown on the page, such as an older name.

hook.description: One or two sentences: what the game is and why it's fun.

deckType.description: What each deck looks like: standard = 52 cards; jokers = 52 + jokers; stripped = some ranks removed.

decks.description: How many decks the game needs: a number (1), or a range [min, max] when it works with more. Use null as max for "or more", e.g. [1, null].

scoringVisual.description: Optional drawing under the scoring, for a moment that is easier to see than to read (a Yaniv call, shooting the moon).

inShort.description: 2–4 plain sentences that explain the whole game before any detail. Required when difficulty is 3.

glossary.description: Terms a first-timer won't know, as [word, meaning].

combos.description: Scoring combinations, each with a drawing.

title.description: Heading instead of the default, e.g. hand rankings.

drinkingGame.description: The game is a drinking game at its core (Kings Cup). Shows the 18+ note at the top and adds the "drinking" tag. Needs age 18+.

sober.description: How to play a drinking game without drinking. Required when drinkingGame is true.

drinking.description: Optional drinking version: extra rules on top of the normal game. The build adds the "drinking" tag automatically.

video.description: A YouTube search phrase, not a link.
